galleries.rule: One distinct query/state, ordered by state frequency, absolute fixed-rival margin change, ID, seed. No random sampling.
galleries.references: Actual fixed reference manifest; exclude identical ID/MMSI; first two same/rival class entries in bank order. No resizing.
galleries.limitation: Outcome-selected examples are not population proportions. Bank order is not learned attention ranking. No new per-reference attention trace or physical causal evidence.
